hero.caption: The Escort Carrier HMS CHASER arrives at Cochin on the Malabar Coast of India with its flight deck packed with aircraft. The aircraft were to be delivered to the Reception Unit, Royal Naval Air Station Cochin. Some arrived practically fully assembled lashed to the flight deck. Others arrived in packing cases.
